title: Observability & Runtime Reliability Audit

CRITICAL.title: Unbounded External Gemini Invocation
CRITICAL.impact: Stalled API call blocks the single solo Celery worker thread indefinitely, halting all asynchronous PDF processing.

CRITICAL.title: Worker Liveness Probe Deadlock (CONT-10)
CRITICAL.impact: Heavy CPU/embedding tasks block celery inspect ping, triggering false liveness failures and worker restarts.

CRITICAL.title: Auth-Service Liveness Probe Cascade
CRITICAL.impact: Liveness probe targeting /actuator/health restarts the JVM pod on transient database disconnects.

HIGH.title: Observability Stack Vacuum
HIGH.impact: 0-byte Prometheus/Alertmanager configs and absent Grafana leave system with zero operational alerting.

HIGH.title: Unstructured Logs & Missing Context Propagation
HIGH.impact: Lack of JSON format and request correlation IDs impedes production troubleshooting and log indexing.

HIGH.title: Uninstrumented Celery & Upload Pipeline
HIGH.impact: No queue backlog metrics or task duration histograms available to operators or HPA.

MEDIUM.title: AI Service Readiness Disk Churn
MEDIUM.impact: Physical write/unlink of .readiness_check.tmp every 10s causes continuous storage I/O churn.

MEDIUM.title: Missing Embedding Model Lifespan Pre-warming
MEDIUM.impact: Lazy model loading on first request introduces up to 73s latency spike.

MEDIUM.title: Missing Celery Soft Time Limit
MEDIUM.impact: Hard SIGKILL after 300s prevents graceful task failure handling and upload cleanup.

LOW.title: Redundant Worker Readiness Probe
LOW.impact: Worker has no Service backend; readiness probe consumes resources without routing benefit.

LOW.title: Frontend InitContainer Root Chown
LOW.impact: nginx-temp-init runs as root to chown emptyDirs; does not affect persistent storage.

INFORMATIONAL.title: PostgreSQL Single-Replica & Cloud HA
INFORMATIONAL.impact: Cloud-scale multi-AZ replication deferred to production cloud migration.

INFORMATIONAL.title: Mutable Image Tags (CONT-06)
INFORMATIONAL.impact: Image digest pinning deferred to release engineering milestone.

proposed_items: 1. Explicit Gemini API request/connection timeout (pass settings.LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
2. Remediate Celery worker liveness probe (replace celery inspect ping with lightweight check; drop readiness probe)
6. Eliminate AI service readiness disk churn (replace file write with os.access check)
7. Inject contextual correlation ID into logging pipeline via contextvars
deferred_items: Full Grafana dashboard deployment and visualization server
PostgreSQL managed clustering and Patroni replication
LLM circuit breaker with degraded keyword fallback (requires clinical safety evaluation)

overall_status: Phase 13.5 Observability & Runtime Reliability Audit Complete — Implementation Pending
